name: Rebels
summary: In K-Pop, Rebels (frequently referred to as the Bad Boys concept or Boy Crush ) is a recurring visual and musical archetype that functions as the male counterpart to the Girl Crush aesthetic.
description: In K-Pop, Rebels (frequently referred to as the Bad Boys concept or Boy Crush ) is a recurring visual and musical archetype that functions as the male counterpart to the Girl Crush aesthetic. The aesthetic utilizes heavy streetwear, techwear garments, distressed denim, leather jackets, and prominent dark makeup, specifically smokey eyeshadow or thick eyeliner. Music videos employing this concept frequently feature industrial, post-apocalyptic, or underground sets. Musically, the concept integrates rave and punk elements, rap, trap, and especially heavy, abrasive EDM production, often paired with anti-establishment or confrontational lyrical themes.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Rebellious, empowerment, motivational, freedom, confidence, independence, charisma, boldness.

visualDNA.colour: Black, red or nocturnal color palettes, and post-apocalyptic colors
